questions.title: 01 Read an augmented row
questions.objective: Translate the augmented row into an equation in x and y.
questions.prerequisites: Read signed coefficients and the right-hand constant.

questions.title: 02 Complete the constant column
questions.objective: Complete the missing constant in the worked row operation.
questions.prerequisites: Multiply and subtract integers in every column.

questions.title: 03 Choose the cancelling operation
questions.objective: Eliminate x from row 2 while leaving row 1 unchanged.
questions.prerequisites: Read a row replacement and choose a cancelling multiple.

questions.title: 04 Explain reversibility
questions.objective: Choose the inverse row operation that restores the original system.
questions.prerequisites: A system requires the same pair to satisfy both equations.

questions.title: 05 Repair the first row error
questions.objective: Find the first incorrect line and correct the value of y.
questions.prerequisites: Check the constant column as well as the coefficient columns.

questions.title: 06 Solve a fresh system
questions.objective: Choose the ordered pair that solves both original equations.
questions.prerequisites: Use exact fractions and preserve the order of x and y.
